answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize biometric entropy to anchor identities, ensuring a single agent cannot replicate across the network like a marble rolling across a wharf. By requiring a unique physical pigment signature for verification, the system forces attackers to acquire scarce biological assets. This imposes a linear cost on identity proliferation, effectively preventing Sybil-based influence dilution by tying every digital node to a distinct, non-transferable human physiological constant.
